## Read in the metadata for HA and list of outgroups
```{r}
# meta<-read.csv("../../../../../data/02_merge/2025-04-02_merged/merged_meta/merged_meta_HA.csv"
meta<-read.csv("../../../../../data/04_clean-align/2025-04-10_clean-aligns-out/cleaned_meta/merged_meta_HA.csv")
resid<-read.csv("../../../../01_fasttrees/ft_root_outlier/2025-04-10_rem-outliers/rem_out/nodup_filt_trim_nuc_HA_rooted_resid.csv")
outs<-read.csv("ha_ougroup_ids.csv", header=F, sep=",")
outs <- outs %>% unite(Accession, V1, V2, remove = F)
outs.a<-outs$Accession
outs.n<-outs$V2

# head(meta$nucname)
# head(meta$isolate_name)
# head(meta)
# meta.2<-meta %>% filter(-keep == 0)
meta.a<-meta %>% separate(nucname, c("Access","Date","Seg"), sep="\\|",remove = F)
head(meta.a)

str_which(meta.a$Access , paste(outs.a, collapse="|"))
str_which(meta.a$isolate_name,outs.a[1])
str_which(meta.a$nucname,as.character(outs.n[1]))
str_which(meta.a$isolate_name,"2.27_XXHM004-E")
meta.3$Access

head(resid)
match.out<-str_which(resid$nucname , paste(outs.a, collapse="|"))
resid.out<-resid[match.out,]
resid.out$segment_id
#why are there two comma sepd?
resid.out<-resid.out %>% separate(segment_id, c("seg_id1","seg_id2"), sep=", ", remove=F)
resid.out

str_subset(meta.a$segment_id, ", ")
str_which(meta.a$segment_id,resid.out$segment_id[1])
# str_which(meta.a$isolate_name,"2.27_XXHM004-E")
```
